description: Scala source code for a Spark Streaming example that consumes messages from Amazon Kinesis streams and performs word count. Includes main application logic, a producer utility, and logging configuration.

classes.name: KinesisWordCountASL
classes.description: Main object for consuming Kinesis stream data and performing word count in Spark Streaming.

classes.name: KinesisWordProducerASL
classes.description: Utility object for producing dummy data onto a Kinesis stream.

classes.name: StreamingExamples
classes.description: Utility object for setting logging levels for Spark Streaming examples.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for KinesisWordCountASL; sets up Spark Streaming context, creates Kinesis streams, processes data, and starts streaming.

methods.name: setStreamingLogLevels
methods.description: Sets Spark Streaming log level to WARN if not already configured.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates and sends dummy data to a Kinesis stream, returning word counts.
